title: Efficient green synthesis of ammonia: from mechanistic understanding to reactor design for potential production
content:

Zhenhui Kou, Dong Shi, Bin Yang, Zhongjian Li, Qinghua Zhang, Jianguo Lu, Tao Zhang, Lecheng Lei, Yuanyuan Li, Liming Dai, Yang Hou
This review summarizes recent advances in green ammonia synthesis technologies. It systematically evaluates catalyst design for converting diverse nitrogen sources, structure–performance relationships and advanced reactor engineering.
